summary: Skyasterix conducts a 300-dice summoning session on the Total Selectable Summons banner to acquire Syonis via the 300-pull guaranteed milestone. He considers Syonis an essential hero, particularly highlighting his strength for Magic Chess as well as boss content. Over the course of 320 total summons, he receives 8 legendary pulls, including duplicates of Aspalta and Bionphray, as well as Lucien, Daphne, Seyir, and Gillian. At the 300-pull milestone, he claims Syonis from the legendary selection pool.

heroes.name: Syonis
heroes.note: A top-tier hero that cannot be skipped if playing Magic Chess, where Shadow is expected to be one of the strongest schools of magic, while also providing value in chief and endgame boss battles.

meta_changes: Corrosion and Shadow elements are key meta archetypes for the season, with Shadow specifically noted as a dominant school in Magic Chess.
tips: Save up to 300 Heliolite dice to guarantee key banner units from total selectable summon events rather than relying purely on random pull luck.
Manage summon resources carefully across the season to preserve dice for upcoming banners like Anneliesis and Aura-based heroes.
title: 🔥300 Dice PULLS FOR SYONIS | Dragonheir: Silent Gods
